title: 第525章 晨曦学府的异常第524章 晨曦超凡社团现状
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
月朗星稀，清风徐来，吹散了白日的燥热。
林道驻足于晨曦学府门前，抬头望向那笼罩校园的淡蓝色光幕，眉头微不可察地皱起：“咦！晨曦学府为何突然升起防御法阵？”
秦墨雪怀中抱着四处张望、发出“咪呜”叫声的山海异兽朏朏，闻言微笑解释道：“师兄有所不知，由于超凡社团的成立，学府又解封被封锁已久的灵脉。
导致学府内灵气浓度正在缓缓回升，据高层所说，为了防止灵气外泄引起外界动荡，这才开启防御阵法进行封锁。”
林道闻言，眼中的疑虑非但这没有消散，反而更浓了几分。
任何防御阵法一旦开启，其消耗的能量往往比灵气外泄量还要大。
为了锁住灵气而耗费巨量能源，这显然是得不偿失之事。
除非……晨曦学府这是特意用防御阵法来掩盖灵脉解封背后的某种真相。
秦墨雪并未察觉林道的深思。
她看向林道怀中熟睡的小悠朵，那双清澈的眸子里翻涌着温柔的情绪，轻声提议道：“师兄，要不让悠朵跟着我睡吧！
你终究是男生，住在多人别墅里若是带着个小女孩，实在多有不便。
我有姐姐独立别墅的钥匙，完全可以将悠朵带去那边休憩。”
林道知晓她的好意，但还是摇了摇头，语气严肃：“师妹，悠朵的情况很特殊，她不能远离我三丈之外。
否则，她会被某些势力瞬间锁定位置，那将会给她带来危险。”
别看圣光教至今毫无动静，仿佛遗忘了小悠朵的存在，但林道心里清楚，这全是山海造化珠的功劳，祂将小丫头的天机彻底遮蔽。
然而，圣光教耗费那般惨痛的代价创造出一尊天使，绝不可能不闻不问。
估计在大夏帝国之外，圣光教的搜寻队伍早已如暗流般涌动。
此次他将小悠朵带到晨曦学府，本意是在自己离开蓝星后，将她托付给太师父坐镇的安全之所。
可是……
林道眼神深邃，再次看向那笼罩学府的蓝色光幕，只怕这个原本的计划，如今也充满了变数。

“悠朵，她……”秦墨雪心中惊异，本想追问缘由。
但见林道轻轻摇头，她便懂事地闭上了嘴。
有些秘密不告知自己，反而是对她的一种保护。
神圣面具暗暗松了口气，随即又忧虑起来。
林道后天就要去虚空世界，小主人若被留下，没有山海造化珠时刻遮掩，很可能会被圣光教捕捉到气息。
尤其是小主人的天使血脉正处于觉醒的关键期，在圣光教眼中，那简直就是黑夜中唯一的明灯。
现在，只能看林道如何安排了。
林道心念一动，让神圣面具施展认知干扰手段，将小悠朵的存在暂时抹去。
随后，他抬腿走向阔别七日的晨曦学府。
秦墨雪抱着朏朏，神情有些恍惚。
她抬眸看向林道怀中，发现那里空空如也，心中不由得一慌，却又记不起刚才他怀里抱着谁，只觉得心里空落落的。
林道一路将秦墨雪送到她所在的别墅旁。
“师兄晚安，明天见。”
“师妹晚安，明天见。”
content_en:
The moon was bright and the stars were sparse, and the gentle breeze blew away the heat of the day.
Lin Dao stopped in front of the gate of Chenxi Academy, looked up at the light blue light curtain covering the campus, and frowned imperceptibly: "Hey! Why did Chenxi Academy suddenly raise a defensive array?"
Qin Moxue held the mountain and sea beast Feixiao, who was looking around and making a "miwu" cry, in her arms. Hearing this, he smiled and explained: "Senior brother, you don't know something. Due to the establishment of the extraordinary society, the school has unlocked the spiritual veins that have been blocked for a long time.
As a result, the concentration of spiritual energy in the school is slowly rising. According to senior officials, in order to prevent the leakage of spiritual energy from causing turmoil in the outside world, a defensive formation was activated to block it. "
When Lin Dao heard this, the doubt in his eyes not only did not dissipate, but became even stronger.
Once any defensive formation is activated, the energy consumed is often greater than the amount of spiritual energy leaked.
Spending a huge amount of energy in order to lock the spiritual energy is obviously a waste that outweighs the gain.
Unless... Chenxi Academy deliberately used defensive formations to cover up some truth behind the unsealing of the spiritual veins.
Qin Moxue did not notice Lin Dao's deep thought.
She looked at the sleeping little Yuduo in Lin Dao's arms, her clear eyes filled with gentle emotions, and suggested softly: "Brother, why don't you let Yuduo sleep with me?
You are a boy after all, and it would be really inconvenient to live in a multi-person villa with a little girl.
I have the key to my sister's independent villa, so I can take Yuduo there to rest. "
Lin Dao knew her good intentions, but he still shook his head and said in a serious tone: "Junior sister, Yuduo's situation is very special. She can't stay away from me for three feet.
Otherwise, she will be instantly locked in position by some forces, which will bring danger to her. "
Even though the Holy Light Sect has not made any movement so far, as if it has forgotten the existence of Xiao Yuduo, Lin Dao knows in his heart that this is all the result of the Shanhai Creation Pearl, which completely obscured the little girl's secret.
However, the Holy Light Religion spent such a painful price to create an angel, and it is absolutely impossible to ignore it.
It is estimated that outside the Great Xia Empire, the search team of the Holy Light Religion has already surged like an undercurrent.
This time he brought Xiao Yuduo to Chenxi Academy, with the intention of entrusting her to a safe place where Grand Master would sit after he left Blue Star.
But...
Lin Dao's eyes were deep and he looked at the blue light curtain covering the school again. He was afraid that this original plan was now full of variables.
"Yuduo, she..." Qin Moxue was surprised and wanted to ask why.
But when Lin Dao shook his head gently, she wisely closed her mouth.
Not telling yourself some secrets is a kind of protection for her.
Holy Mask secretly breathed a sigh of relief, then became worried again.
Lin Dao will go to the void world the day after tomorrow. If the little master is left behind without the mountain and sea creation beads to cover him at all times, it is very likely that the Holy Light Sect will capture his aura.
Especially the little master's angelic bloodline is in the critical period of awakening. In the eyes of the Holy Light Religion, it is simply the only bright light in the dark night.
Now, we can only see how Lindao arranges it.
With a thought, Lin Dao asked the Holy Mask to use cognitive interference to temporarily erase Xiao Yuduo's existence.
Then, he walked towards Chenxi Academy after seven days of absence.
Qin Moxue hugged Zhaoxiao, looking a little dazed.
She raised her eyes and looked at Lin Dao's arms, and found that there was nothing there. She couldn't help but panic, but she couldn't remember who he was holding in his arms just now, and she just felt empty in her heart.
Lin Dao sent Qin Moxue all the way to her villa.
"Good night, senior brother, see you tomorrow."
"Good night, junior sister, see you tomorrow."
